_comment: Blocks the Occultism Vitality Compass from binding to a player. Combined with an Entity Wormhole a bound compass teleports to the target or reels it in with a fishing rod, which bypasses /tpa. Mirrors the runtime addition in kubejs/server_scripts/tags/item_entity_tags.js. Keep them in sync; this datapack copy is the static fallback if KubeJS fails to load.
